about_the_game:
Pogo Together – Ready to Bounce?

Pogo Together is a multiplayer pogo stick parkour game that tests your reflexes, balance, and patience.
Players must guide their automatically jumping characters through challenging obstacle courses while competing against others. Every bounce is a risk, every landing a victory.

Jump, Balance, and Win

In Pogo Together, your character jumps automatically — your only task is to control the direction and timing.
Maintain your momentum and balance as you leap across dangerous platforms. It may look simple, but mastering it takes skill and precision.

Headbutt, Knock Down, and Annoy

It’s not just about parkour — it’s chaos!
Headbutt other players to knock them off balance and clear your way to victory. But be careful — they can do the same to you. Pogo Together pushes your timing, reactions, and nerves to the limit.

Customize Your Style

Everyone bounces differently!
Show off your personality by customizing your character and pogo stick with unique colors, patterns, and styles. Stand out from the crowd as you jump your way to the top.

Simple to Play, Hard to Master

Pogo Together offers chaotic fun with simple mechanics.
Every jump, fall, and laugh brings you closer to mastery.
Play with friends or compete online — only the best will stay standing!

short_description: Pogo Together is a multiplayer hardcore parkour game where you and your friends try to reach the top using pogo sticks. Your character never stops jumping, You just control the movement and timing. Kick your friends, laugh together and race to the finish line!
